description: Create documents belonging to two different users, request the other user's document through the real authorization handler, and assert access is denied.
Have two clients update the same document version concurrently through the repository API; assert one succeeds and the other receives a conflict instead of silently overwriting data.
Create a local fixture with title set to Example and assert that the fixture's title is Example. No production code is called.

A temporary validation of a completed one-off color change: search the stylesheet source and assert the newly requested hex literal is present. There is no lasting semantic design requirement for that literal.
